tool.name: Unsloth
tool.summary: Ultra-fast open-source fine-tuning framework providing 2x-5x faster training speeds and up to 80% lower VRAM memory usage for Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and DeepSeek.
tool.architecture: Custom OpenAI Triton manual backpropagation GPU kernels.
tool.usage:
from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(
    model_name="unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-bnb-4bit",
    max_seq_length=2048,
    load_in_4bit=True
)
tool.benchmarks: 5x faster training, 0% accuracy loss compared to standard Hugging Face Trainer.
tool.limitations: Exclusively tailored for NVIDIA GPUs (Compute Capability 7.0+).
